doubts: Network page for the Wanganui valley tracks: four tracks are each given as their own way because each has its own heading, time and start. The main way is taken as the first, Road end to Hunters Hut. The road end is not a feature in the packet, so its ref is null. The Lambert Tops and Blue Lookout routes both end at the deer posts; the page says the Blue Lookout route is 'to Blue Lookout' (peak not used as end, since the text gives the deer posts as the marked end). The Lambert River bridge was destroyed and 'Crossing on foot may be possible in low conditions', so no ford is recorded for it. The Wanganui River cableway crossing on the main way is not a ford and is recorded with no how. Steep Creek is said to be passed with riverbed and flats 'crossed', with no crossing of the creek itself stated. Smyth Hut is the end of the Hunters Hut to Smyth Hut way but is not in huts, since huts lists those the main way passes or ends at. The Hunters Hut to Smyth Hut way says Access is difficult due to sustained flood damage, and that the Wanganui River swing bridge was destroyed, so no crossing is recorded there.
